items.title: Arthur Baron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: My wife and I worked up some songs like “It’s a Wonderful World” and “What the World Needs Now” is love sweet love.

ctx.x: Privilege, that’s the perfect word. And I don’t like that. So we called up all these people and had various responses but all extremely positive. And there was also something, when you bring a conversation up to the next level, when you say what you have to say, there’s a pause. Because our black friends hadn’t heard anything like this from us. And then they came in and spoke and boy I’ll tell you my wife and I were nervous during that pause. Did we do something wrong? Are we too liberal? Are we too something?…

show and it’s just continuing. And they bring up all these issues. You know it’s just, I mean I think, I mean it took a pandemic and then to have a brutal killing of a man, a man first, then put a black man. Black Lives Matter. And one thing I’ve got to say, I understand. This is not the time to be spouting out white lives matter too. We got the privilege. We don’t need to hear that. What we need to hear is what I just said, Black Lives Matter. And I believe this happened and it was more intense, more stirring…
